title: NCPU: Towards Cell-Inspired Spatial Computing
abstract: arXiv:2611.32750v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simple cellular automata (CAs) can be computationally universal, but their rules are designed by hand. We train Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs), which learn a local update rule by gradient descent, to compute exact digital logic. Bits are encoded as clusters of cells on a 2D grid, and a result reaches the output only by propagating through intermediate cells. One model is trained per task: logic gates, 4- and 8-bit ripple-carry adders, and a preliminary 8-bit arithmetic logic unit (ALU). All gate and adder models reach 100% bit correctness in 10 of 10 seeds, and exhaustive tests over all input pairs find at most 1 error in 256 (4-bit) and 7 in 65,536 (8-bit). Adders trained on operands of up to 3 bits generalize to 8 bits. The adders propagate the carry as a wave, with a delay of about 3.5 steps per bit of the carry chain. Outputs are correct only within the trained rollout length.

translated_title: NCPU：迈向受细胞启发的空间计算
translated_abstract: 简单的元胞自动机（CA）可以具备计算通用性，但其规则需要手工设计。我们训练神经元胞自动机（NCA）——通过梯度下降学习局部更新规则——来执行精确的数字逻辑计算。比特被编码为二维网格上的细胞簇，计算结果只有通过中间细胞的传播才能到达输出端。每个任务训练一个模型：逻辑门、4位和8位行波进位加法器，以及一个初步的8位算术逻辑单元（ALU）。所有门电路和加法器模型在10个随机种子中全部达到100%的位级正确率，对所有输入组合的穷举测试发现，4位加法器在256个测试中最多出现1个错误，8位加法器在65,536个测试中最多出现7个错误。仅用最多3位操作数训练的加法器能够泛化到8位。加法器以波的形式传播进位，进位链中每比特的延迟约为3.5步。输出仅在训练的演化步数范围内保持正确。
tldr: 该论文提出用神经元胞自动机（NCA）通过梯度下降学习局部更新规则来实现精确的数字逻辑计算，将比特编码为二维网格上的细胞簇，成功训练出逻辑门、4位和8位加法器及初步的8位ALU，全部达到100%位级正确率，且仅用3位操作数训练的加法器可泛化到8位。
en_tdlr: This paper trains Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) to compute exact digital logic by encoding bits as cell clusters on a 2D grid, achieving 100% bit correctness on logic gates, 4- and 8-bit ripple-carry adders, and a preliminary 8-bit ALU, with adders generalizing from 3-bit operands to 8 bits.
